Remark
[Space-time splitting interpretation] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0327 1. ch15:15.39\group Ancient Solutions and Solitons

The steady soliton equation makes $\nabla f+\partial _t$ parallel for the space-time connection. The ancient Harnack estimate gives nonnegative space-time curvature, while attainment of the scalar-curvature maximum gives a null direction. Theorem 6 is thus a space-time splitting theorem.
